ne2beab7c16.headline: Azerbaijan reveals average export price of oil in 7 months
ne2beab7c16.summary: The average export price of one barrel of Azeri Light (CIF) oil in world markets for January to July 2025 has been revealed in an APA-Economics report.
ne2beab7c16.why: Azeri Light is a benchmark crude grade exported by Azerbaijan, and its price drives the country's oil export revenues.

n7363f1e2fc.headline: African Markets – Factors to watch on Aug 22
n7363f1e2fc.summary: Reuters' preview lists company announcements, scheduled economic indicators, debt and currency moves and political events that may affect African markets on Friday. Asian stocks were awaiting a speech by Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.
n7363f1e2fc.why: Pre-market briefings summarise the scheduled events that can drive African equity, bond and currency markets on a given day.

na4f89be14d.headline: South African Markets – Factors to watch on August 22
na4f89be14d.summary: The rand weakened on Thursday as investors looked ahead to the US Federal Reserve's Jackson Hole symposium. Gold Fields is scheduled to report half-year results and an inflation-linked bond auction is on the calendar.
na4f89be14d.why: The rand is a key emerging-market currency and South Africa's mining sector, including gold producers, is central to its equity market.

impacts.name: South African rand
impacts.why: The rand weakened on Thursday as traders awaited the Jackson Hole symposium.

ncae7b2f1cd.headline: FCMB Asset Management and TLG Capital set to launch Series 2
ncae7b2f1cd.summary: FCMB Asset Management and TLG Capital are set to launch Series 2 after an oversubscribed Series 1. Series 1 allocated capital to five mid-market operators and drew money from 16 institutional investors.
ncae7b2f1cd.why: Private capital funds that back mid-sized African businesses are a source of growth finance for sectors such as agriculture, healthcare and clean energy.

nb67eebbf1b.headline: South African rand flat ahead of Fed remarks
nb67eebbf1b.summary: The South African rand was flat in early trade on Friday as investors awaited Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell's speech at the Jackson Hole symposium. The speech could offer clues on the monetary policy path.
nb67eebbf1b.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and risk-sensitive emerging-market currencies often move on US Federal Reserve policy signals that shape global capital flows.

impacts.name: South African rand
impacts.why: The rand was flat in early trade while investors awaited the Fed chair's speech, which could shift the monetary policy outlook.

n893b5830de.headline: Saudi Arabia to expand pension and savings programme to foreign workers
n893b5830de.summary: Saudi Arabia is set to launch a voluntary pension and savings programme that includes foreign workers for the first time. The aim is to boost household savings and reduce remittances, and the IMF welcomed the plan.
n893b5830de.why: Pension and savings reforms affect household savings, labour costs and fund flows in Saudi Arabia, a major Gulf economy and oil producer.

n0c9ff1444d.headline: Your morning coffee is about to get more expensive: How to keep your costs down
n0c9ff1444d.summary: Coffee prices are already up this year, and 50% tariffs on Brazil threaten to push them higher. Consumers may face higher costs for coffee.
n0c9ff1444d.why: Brazil is the world's largest coffee producer, so trade measures affecting its exports feed directly into global arabica and robusta prices.

n00f3db36a8.headline: South Africa opens freight rail network to private firms
n00f3db36a8.summary: South Africa's government said it will allow private firms to run trains on the national freight rail network. The move aims to boost efficiency as state-owned Transnet struggles with equipment shortages and maintenance backlogs.
n00f3db36a8.why: Transnet runs South Africa's freight rail and port services, which are central to the country's mining and export logistics. Private access could change capacity and costs for exporters.

n46e42afd08.headline: Bravo Brio Restaurants files for bankruptcy
n46e42afd08.summary: Bravo Brio Restaurants has filed for bankruptcy. The company owns the Bravo! Italian Kitchen and Brio Italian Grille restaurant brands.
n46e42afd08.why: Bravo Brio operates casual dining chains in the United States, and bankruptcy filings signal financial distress in the restaurant sector.

n77e29fe538.headline: Cracker Barrel Lost Almost $100 Million in One Day Because of Logo Change
n77e29fe538.summary: Cracker Barrel had a sharp fall on Wall Street on Thursday, August 21, with the company losing almost $100 million in one day because of its logo change.
n77e29fe538.why: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store is a US restaurant and retail chain, and brand changes can affect customer sentiment and sales.
n77e29fe538.why_moved: The input links the one-day loss on Wall Street directly to the company's logo change.

n5e3817a153.headline: US Sanctions Additional ICC Members for Lawfare
n5e3817a153.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the ICC continues to disregard national sovereignty and facilitate lawfare against American and Israeli nationals. The US is sanctioning additional ICC members.
n5e3817a153.why: US sanctions on international court officials can restrict financial dealings with designated persons and affect cross-border legal and compliance risk for banks and firms.

n2202d9a167.headline: Employer Bulletin August 2025: Why Payroll and Retail Sectors Must Gear Up Now for Vaping Products Tax
n2202d9a167.summary: UK retailers and employers are being urged to prepare now for the Vaping Products Duty. Excise charges and mandatory duty stamps are due to come into force in 2026.
n2202d9a167.why: Excise duties change the cost base and compliance requirements for tobacco and vaping retailers. The duty is set by UK tax policy.

nc82c9d635b.headline: New county property tax credits in the works
nc82c9d635b.summary: The Hawaii County Council voted 8-1 to approve a bill amending the county's real property tax credit system. The measure passed on first reading.
nc82c9d635b.why: Property tax rules affect homeowners, landlords and local government revenue. Changes to county tax credits can shift the tax burden on real estate owners.

n7f9ce9edd8.headline: Canada-Ghana Chamber welcomes move to scrap minimum capital requirement for foreign investors
n7f9ce9edd8.summary: The Canada-Ghana Chamber welcomed the move to scrap the minimum capital requirement for foreign investors. The presidency said it would keep strict fiscal discipline.
n7f9ce9edd8.why: Minimum capital rules shape the entry costs for foreign companies, so changes affect the flow of foreign direct investment into an economy.

n81a9ebfe91.headline: MTN SA's fight to regain market share
n81a9ebfe91.summary: MTN will expand its distribution and dealer network and improve location-based pricing in South Africa to win back prepaid market share, as it revises earnings targets.
n81a9ebfe91.why: MTN Group is a major African mobile operator, and its South African unit is a large part of its revenue and subscriber base.

n6de5ed4c4f.headline: UBS lifts S&P 500 annual target for second time in two months
n6de5ed4c4f.summary: UBS Global Wealth Management lifted its year-end target for the S&P 500 for the second time in two months. The bank cited corporate earnings strength, easing trade tensions and other expectations.
n6de5ed4c4f.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US equities, and strategist forecasts influence institutional asset allocation.

ncdb17b3e33.headline: Stock market ends 6-session winning streak amid weak global cues
ncdb17b3e33.summary: Domestic Indian equity indices settled lower on Friday, ending a six-session winning streak as investor sentiment turned cautious ahead of the US Fed Chair's speech.
ncdb17b3e33.why: India's benchmark indices, including the BSE Sensex, track large listed Indian companies and are a key gauge for foreign and domestic investors in the country's equity market.
ncdb17b3e33.why_moved: Investor sentiment turned cautious amid weak global cues and selling, ahead of the US Fed Chair's speech, per the report.

n3733689eac.headline: India’s next leap is fifth-generation fighter jets with home-built engines: Rajnath Singh at ET WLF
n3733689eac.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh confirmed a new partnership with French firm Safran to co-develop engines for India's AMCA fighter. The AMCA, India's first fifth-generation stealth fighter, is to roll out prototypes by 2027.
n3733689eac.why: Safran is a French aerospace and defence group that makes aircraft engines. Defence programmes with foreign partners create long-term contracts and technology transfers.

impacts.name: Safran
impacts.why: Safran's partnership to co-develop AMCA engines adds a major defence engine programme with India.

n07ad3a497c.headline: Treasurer mulls making tax fairer for young Australians
n07ad3a497c.summary: Australia's Treasurer is considering changes to the tax system, which critics call unfair because retirees can earn the same income as working households.
n07ad3a497c.why: Tax policy changes can alter household disposable income, superannuation and retirement incentives, with implications for the broader economy.

n8de95bae79.headline: TARIFF REBATE DISMISSED: Bessent shoots down Trump stimulus
n8de95bae79.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the administration will pay down the national debt before sending any tariff rebate payments.
n8de95bae79.why: Tariff revenue and any rebate payments affect US fiscal policy, government borrowing needs and the outlook for Treasury issuance.

n1c15ea3cc0.headline: RBI appoints Indranil Bhattacharyya as ex-officio member of MPC
n1c15ea3cc0.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's central board approved the nomination of Executive Director Indranil Bhattacharyya as an ex-officio member of the Monetary Policy Committee. The decision was announced on Friday.
n1c15ea3cc0.why: The Monetary Policy Committee sets the Reserve Bank of India's benchmark interest rate, which influences Indian bond yields and the rupee.

nf276a613c1.headline: In the news today: Air Canada ramping up to near full schedule
nf276a613c1.summary: Air Canada says it expects to be operating close to its full network schedule by Friday. The update comes from a Canadian Press news roundup.
nf276a613c1.why: Air Canada is Canada's largest airline and its flight network drives travel demand, fuel use and airport traffic. Its schedule recovery is closely watched by investors in the sector.

nf5a415371e.headline: Reuters poll sees deeper RBNZ cuts to 2.5% in Q4
nf5a415371e.summary: A Reuters poll sees the Reserve Bank of New Zealand cutting its policy rate to 2.5% in Q4. The previous poll expected a rate of 3%.
nf5a415371e.why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets the official cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the New Zealand dollar and bond yields. Economist poll expectations shape how markets price future rate moves.

n69026d7203.headline: How Trump Will Decide Which Chips Act Companies Must Give Up Equity
n69026d7203.summary: The administration is not eyeing equity in chipmakers increasing US investment, such as TSMC and Micron, but may take stakes in others. The criteria for selection are still being decided.
n69026d7203.why: The CHIPS Act provides US subsidies for semiconductor manufacturing, so government equity stakes would change how federal support is structured for chipmakers.

n4c469ea9e9.headline: California mulling its own EV incentives after Trump dumps federal tax credits
n4c469ea9e9.summary: California is considering offering electric vehicle incentives using state funds after the federal government dropped national tax credits for EV buyers.
n4c469ea9e9.why: Electric vehicle purchase incentives affect demand for EVs and the manufacturers and charging networks that serve them.

n70fd7ba733.headline: With U.S. pressure, concern emerging about fate of online streaming, news bills
n70fd7ba733.summary: The US State Department criticised Canada's Online News Act in a human rights report, raising concern about the future of online streaming and news legislation under US pressure.
n70fd7ba733.why: Canada's digital legislation affects how large US tech platforms pay for news and content, so US-Canada trade and regulatory tensions matter to investors in those firms.

n1645a531cd.headline: Thailand plans measures to boost consumption and tourism
n1645a531cd.summary: Thailand is considering tax incentives to stimulate consumer spending in the final months of the year, according to Deputy Finance Minister Julapant Amornvivat. The economy is projected to grow over 2% this year.
n1645a531cd.why: Thailand is a major Southeast Asian economy where tourism and household consumption are key growth drivers for investors.

nf78c72ea3d.headline: CNOOC Completes New Refinery and Petrochemical Complex in East China
nf78c72ea3d.summary: CNOOC has completed a new refinery and petrochemical complex in Ningbo, East China. The project raises olefins capacity to 1.8 million tons per year and enhances crude processing.
nf78c72ea3d.why: CNOOC is China's major offshore oil and gas producer, and new refining and petrochemical capacity affects its downstream earnings and regional fuel and chemical supply.

impacts.name: CNOOC
impacts.why: Completion of the complex adds olefins and crude processing capacity to CNOOC's downstream business.

ne35b0d7175.headline: Stocks climb as investors bet on rate cut following Jerome Powell speech
ne35b0d7175.summary: Stocks climbed sharply on Friday as investors read Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell's speech as open to a rate cut, which took the market by surprise.
ne35b0d7175.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and expectations for rate cuts influence equity valuations, bond yields and the dollar.
ne35b0d7175.why_moved: Investors read Powell's remarks as openness to a rate cut, a surprise that drove a large upward move in stocks.

n23f1ba332f.headline: Canada PM Carney Plans to Drop 25% Tariff on Some U.S. Imports -- 2nd Update
n23f1ba332f.summary: Canada said it would remove its 25% tariff on about half of the U.S. goods it has targeted since March as a goodwill gesture to reset trade ties.
n23f1ba332f.why: Canada and the United States are each other's largest trading partners, so tariff changes affect exporters, prices and cross-border supply chains.
n23f1ba332f.why_moved: Canada's tariff removal on some U.S. goods is a trade-policy shift that changes the cost of cross-border goods.

n9742058ece.headline: Malaysia's approved investments in H1 up 18.7 per cent on year
n9742058ece.summary: Malaysia secured 190.3 billion ringgit (44.98 billion USD) in approved investments during the first half of 2025, marking an 18.7% increase year-on-year.
n9742058ece.why: Investment approvals indicate economic growth prospects and capital inflows, important for Malaysia's development and investor confidence.

n086c908cc2.headline: Tomorrow's fuel prices (23 Aug 68): check latest PTT, Bangchak, Shell oil prices
n086c908cc2.summary: Retail gasoline, Gasohol and diesel prices for 23 August at PTT, Bangchak, Shell and other stations are being published. The listing covers major Thai fuel retailers.
n086c908cc2.why: PTT and Bangchak are major Thai energy companies whose retail fuel pricing reflects crude and refined product costs and domestic policy.

impacts.name: PTT
impacts.why: PTT's retail fuel price listing is the subject of the report.

nbd63df3fcf.headline: South Africa: Inflation in July at Highest Level in Nine Months
nbd63df3fcf.summary: Statistics South Africa reported consumer prices rose 3.5% year on year in July, up from 3% in June. The reading matched the median forecast of economists polled by Bloomberg.
nbd63df3fcf.why: Consumer inflation informs the South African Reserve Bank's interest rate decisions, which affect bond yields and the rand.

nf1969fe628.summary: US reciprocal tariffs are hitting Taiwan's dolphinfish exports, and President Lai Ching-te met fishing operators in Yilan on government support measures.
nf1969fe628.why: Reciprocal tariffs raise the cost of exporting to the United States, which can hurt exporters in targeted sectors.
